arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
# Test {:+d}
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{:+d}')
    result = p.parse('123')
    print('Result:', result)
except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', type(e).__name__, str(e))

# Test {:-d}
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{:-d}')
    result = p.parse('-123')
    print('Result with -d:', result)
except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', type(e).__name__, str(e))

# Test extract_format for sign specifiers
print('extract_format({:+d}):', parse.extract_format('+d', {}))
print('extract_format({:-d}):', parse.extract_format('-d', {}))
print('extract_format({: d}):', parse.extract_format(' d', {}))
"
